//about: The status-check contexts branch protection on main requires, by rendered name: the union of what GitHub held when ci.yml's four jobs were added and what the plan that added them named. GitHub holds the set and nothing offline can read it, so this is the tree's one copy of it, which tests/ci_workflows.rs and .github/ci-shape/ci-shape.test.mjs both read; `setup_github_governance.py --verify` is its drift gate against GitHub. A change here is a governance change, never an edit to match a renamed job.
